TEXT: After school, I immediately brought Kirino to the Akihabara station.
I'm not sure if we're early, but Saori and Kuroneko are nowhere to be seen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Heh～, so this is Akihabara.
This girl, she's looking around as if this is her first time here.
Come to think of it... this was also where we met Kuroneko and Saori for the first time.
Ooh, somehow it feels like things will go smoothly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Uwah, there are so many people just like you in groups～
...Or not.
Will everything go smoothly as it is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Uwah! Isn't that person overdoing it? It's already out of fashion to be carrying a rucksack, and there's some rod-like thing sticking out of it...
Actually, only a minority of otaku dress in that style. But because it's rare, seeing it leaves a very strong impact.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, even I think it's too much...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kiririn-shi! Kyousuke-shi! Over here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wait, Saori?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: H-Hey... Don't tell me the duo you were telling me about..

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yes, the big one is Saori, and the black one is Kuroneko. They're your friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ick...
Well, it's normal to be shocked.
I did cough out the water I was drinking when we first met too...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well, well, Kyousuke-shi. The situation this time seems quite serious, 'tis not?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yeah, now I can't help but think that you were born under the star of calamity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry about that, you two. For making you specially come out here.
Which reminds me, Saori's house is located pretty far away.
And yet, she agreed to meet up once I contacted her. I really am no match for her.
But... the important person here, Kirino, was like this, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Right, this is a dream... A bad dream...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey Kirino, snap back into reality.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Uhh.
This Kirino... she's actually looking at Saori and Kuroneko as if they were some rare species.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Say, Saori... Right now, Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha, you don't have to finish saying it, I fully understand, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well then, first I'll introduce myself to Kiririn-shi. I am Saori Bageena. Would it be better if I say 'Nice to meet you'?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: And this person is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph, it's not necessary to give out my name. I'm sure she has heard of my name just now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: D-Don't say that, I'm sure you understand what's going on about Kirino from Saori, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It can't be helped if "Nii-san" puts it this way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Nii-san～?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey! You, that was on purpose, wasn't it?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: My name is Kuroneko. You should carve my name onto your tiny soul, so as never to forget about it again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh?
Uwah?! Without delay, Kirino had broken into her displeased mode caused by Kuroneko's way of speech!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey you. could you stop the nonsense you've been spouting since the start?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph... At least her mouth is still the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: In that case, could you also stop putting on that remarkable fashionista style of yours? Akiba is the wrong place for that, you're an eyesore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-What are you saying?! This is this year's fashionable...!
What's with this... Based on this back-and-forth argument, isn't it the same as before...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now, now, you two. This isn't the place to have a lover's quarrel. How about we promptly go to the maid cafe we frequent?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: C-Come on, Saori also said it, so have a little self-control here, okay? Let's hurry to the maid cafe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I'm... not going...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey Kirino, what are you saying? Everybody gathered here just for the sake of recovering your memories, there's no meaning if you're not around!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But isn't a maid cafe a place where gross otakus go and gather in to see the waitresses dressed up in maid costumes?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: How could I go... to such a place?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kiririn-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It doesn't matter if you don't wish to come. Shall we go, "Nii-san"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Don't decide that on your own! I don't want to walk together with such disgusting otakus!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: And also, I'll say this now since there's a chance, but do you two know how prominent you are?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: To put it across clearly, I don't believe we're friends. It's a bad joke, right?
H-Hey... she can't joke about what she has just said.
Saori's spirits are obviously down, and Kuroneko's eyes are also a little wet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, stop it, Kirino. These two are here today for your sake.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's not like I asked them to. Rather, could you tell me in advance if we're meeting people like this?
Tch... This girl, is she still being stubborn?
A-Anyway, it'll be bad at this rate if I don't follow up and revert the situation!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Say, Saori. Kirino is currently...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I understand, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You understand... what exactly?
W-What's wrong? What's with that strange exchanging of looks... Rather, w-why did the two of them smile so suddenly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-What's so funny?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Funny? Right, everything about you is just simply laughable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You said you've lost your memories? If you're going to lie, you'll need to come up with something better than that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're just like a kid that would bandage her own wrist for no reason. You just want others to make you feel special, and worry for you. That's why you

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: came up with this kind of setting for your own wilfulness, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Haha, a splendid Chuunibyou.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What are the two of you saying?! I'm being serious...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Thou need not feel embarrassed, Kiririn-shi. 'Tis something anyone can get, just like measles.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, I know your feelings like the palm of my hand. It can't be just "anyone", right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: There's only one person you wish to turn and look at you... That must be your elder brother that you just love too much, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-Wha...?!
Ooooooh?! I recognize this atmosphere.
Earthquakes, thunderstorms, fires, little sisters, before any natural disaster like those happens, everything will stop like this, and then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-W-W-W-W-Who would love this kind of a guy?! You Jakigan Chuunibyou girl-----------!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: C-C-C-C-Control yourself, Kirino----!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Let me go! I'm going to kill her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey, don't say something so dangerous in front of the station! H-Hey, don't struggle! Don't elbow me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Babbling nonsense just when I decide to listen for a while, who's a Chuunibyou?! Who's a kid?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That all clearly describes you! Even though you're a damn wannabe writer that can only write self-satisfying Jakigan novels!
Y-You... just completely stepped on a landmine for Kuroneko.
Even if your own book got published, that's too much...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Wait, hey. How did you know about Kuroneko's ambition to be a novelist?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh? Ah...
It's true that I've showed Kirino the novel Kuroneko wrote. However, I didn't tell her if it was a professional novel or an amateur doujin story.
Even if I explained, Kirino wouldn't have understood since she doesn't have otaku knowledge.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Which means...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: M-My... memories... have returned...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-S-S-S...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Success-------!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: D-Don't hug my head! Ahhh, enough, let me go!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my? So you really did lose your memories? I really thought you had measles.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: A setting like memory loss is something only shallow-minded humans could have thought up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: L-Like I said, don't put me together with your Jakigan nonsense!
Kirino and Kuroneko started a lover's quarrel.
This is quite a common spectacle, but it's been a long time since then, so I just...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh, Kyousuke-shi? Are you crying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Shut up!
These are tears accumulated from fatigue and stress!
Damn, that Saori... She smiled mischievously like she saw through everything...
Eh... Saw through everything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...By any chance, were you both putting up an act just to anger Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh, I really don't know what you're talking about...
Then don't put a ':3' face and start whistling away.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, are you seriously saying that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: T-Then how else could I have put it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...The one saying this isn't the true Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Huh? What's with this about the real me?
Yeah, I get it. To the current Kirino, that phrase is forbidden as it denies her existence.
Nevertheless, I couldn't keep it in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My little sister is someone with a cheeky and extremely irritating personality, she calmly tells people to die, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Even so, she's not a person that will hurt her friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why... the current you isn't my little sister. Even if Dad or Mom acknowledges you, I won't acknowledge you.
I yelled as my emotions overflowed.
Kirino's face went pale and didn't move as if time had stopped.
Hmph, I'm don't care anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuroneko, Saori. I'm really sorry for asking you both to accompany me today. I'll treat you both at the maid cafe.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Is this all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...There's no problem, let's go.
Both of them were confused, looking from Kirino to me, but eventually they started walking behind me.
For an instant, I saw Kirino with her her eyes cast down at the corner of my vision. However, I don't intend to stop.
In the end, Kirino didn't come to the maid cafe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that how the current... How the 'new you' really feels?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: D-Do you have a problem with it?
Damn it, isn't this exactly the same as three days ago?
In other words, there's no turning back from the catastrophe here due to her dishonest personality, right?
Good grief, what should I do now?
Somehow, I need to let them know that what she just said isn't her true feelings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Of course we have a problem with it. Just what do you think of us?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuroneko?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What? Didn't I say I think of you guys as disgusting otakus?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Disgusting... Huh. Then, I wonder if you could explain which part is "disgusting"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: H-Huh? What are you saying? I'll say it's disgusting if I feel that it is!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I see. You define everything outside of your sense of aesthetics as "disgusting". It's an opinion quite like that of a brainless troll on the internet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wha-?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: By that definition, your appearance is "disgusting" in my eyes. Quickly undress or just get out of my sight, why don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Y...You are one to talk! Take off that sultry black dress right now?! It makes me feel hot to the point of death just by looking at you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph, you said the same thing the first time we met. Not only is your vocabulary, even your thinking is lacking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Gggmmmmnnnnnggghhh!!
Oooh, that's Kuroneko for you. She has been researching on how to point out Kirino's faults during this past year.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...However, I don't dislike that part of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's quite stimulating to quarrel with you, and most of all it's very enjoyable to see you flip out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wha... Wha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuroneko... You...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It looks your true nature hasn't changed despite losing your memories... Very well. I will acknowledge you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...It's just as she said. I understood after looking at the two of you arguing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: The you that doesn't acknowledge otakus is still you. You've just broken the shell known as your self and changed yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kiririn-shi didn't change at all. She's still our friend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You two...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Tch... I'm not happy about being acknowledged by otakus.
Kirino... You can't hide your smile, just as usual.
However... That's right. Even if she were to forget about her otaku interests, Kirino is still Kirino. My little sister.
